text: After Arnab and his parents [run over an elderly woman in heavy rain|trigger|a sudden accident or attack], police searching her forest hut find Rukhsana [chained inside|images|ropes, cages and executions]. Arnab, who runs a printing press and is engaged to the nurse Piyali, takes the strange girl home, where she knows nothing of the world and suffers demonic visions. Rukhsana [falls in love with him|wants|a lover to possess], but Professor Qasim Ali, who once hunted the children of [the demon Ifrit|threat|the devil and dark gods], has been searching for her for years.
